description:
Free features:
* Subscribe to podcasts
* Auto-download episodes
* Video playback
* Livestream playback
* Drag-and-drop queue
* Boostagrams (Value for Value)
* Streaming Value (Value for Value)
* Chapters (Podcasting 2.0)
* Transcripts (Podcasting 2.0)
* Cross-app comments (Podcasting 2.0)
* Screen-reader accessibility
Premium features:
* Sync your subscriptions across devices
* Sync your queue across devices
* Sync your history across devices
* New episode notifications
* Livestream notifications
* Create clips
* Create playlists
* Create a profile
All Podverse software is provided under a free and open source license (AGPLv3).
